info.title: Melee.gg API
info.description: The Melee.gg API provides access to tournament management and other features.

get.summary:
Executes a saved admin report identified by its GUID string, applies pagination,
and returns the result set as dynamic objects.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The GUID string of the report to execute.

parameters.name: variables.page
parameters.description: The requested page number, which may be null. Defaults to 1 if not specified.

parameters.name: variables.pageSize
parameters.description:
The requested size of the page, which may be null.
Minimum size is 5, maximum size is 250, and default size is 25.

parameters.name: variables.ignoreCache
parameters.description: Whether to ignore the cache and fetch fresh data. Defaults to false.

200.description: Report executed and results returned.

401.description: User is not authenticated or not authorized for the report.

404.description: Report definition or user not found.

get.summary: Retrieves detailed information about a specific tournament by its ID.
get.description:
This endpoint is protected and requires staff-level authorization to access. It returns a comprehensive
data transfer object (DTO) representing the tournament, including all relevant details for display or further processing.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the tournament to retrieve.

200.description: Returns the tournament data transfer object (DTO) if the tournament is found and the request is authorized.

403.description: Unauthorized - If the requesting user does not have the necessary staff-level authorization to access tournament details.

404.description: Not Found - If a tournament with the specified ID does not exist.

get.summary: Lists tournaments accessible to the authenticated staff member, with support for pagination.
get.description:
This endpoint requires staff-level authorization and utilizes basic authentication to determine the requesting user's identity.
It returns tournaments where the authenticated user is listed as staff directly or through an organization.

The response is a list of tournament DTOs (Data Transfer Objects), providing a standardized view of tournament details suitable for external consumption.

parameters.name: startDateFrom
parameters.description:
Earliest tournament start date (inclusive).  
If omitted, no lower bound is applied.

parameters.name: startDateTo
parameters.description:
Latest tournament start date (inclusive).  
If omitted, no upper bound is applied.

parameters.name: tournamentId
parameters.description: Optional tournamentId to search for.

parameters.name: lastUpdatedDate
parameters.description: Optional filter for tournaments on this date or after.

parameters.name: variables.page
parameters.description: The requested page number, which may be null. Defaults to 1 if not specified.

parameters.name: variables.pageSize
parameters.description:
The requested size of the page, which may be null.
Minimum size is 5, maximum size is 250, and default size is 25.

parameters.name: variables.ignoreCache
parameters.description: Whether to ignore the cache and fetch fresh data. Defaults to false.

200.description: Returns a paginated list of tournament DTOs accessible to the authenticated staff member.

401.description: Unauthorized - If the authentication fails or the user does not have the required authorization level.

get.summary: Retrieves a decklist by its unique identifier.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the decklist.

parameters.name: includeCardAttributes
parameters.description: Flag to include gameplay attributes for each card in the decklist.

200.description: Returns the requested decklist as JSON.

403.description: Unauthorized - If the requester does not have the required staff-level authorization.

404.description: Not Found - If no decklist exists with the given identifier.

get.summary: Retrieves a decklist for a specific player and format.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The player's unique identifier.

parameters.name: formatId
parameters.description: The id of the format of the decklist to retrieve.

parameters.name: includeCardAttributes
parameters.description: Flag to include gameplay attributes for each card in the decklist.

200.description: Returns the requested player's decklist as JSON.

403.description: Forbidden - If the organization associated with the decklist does not have the permission to download decklists.

404.description: Not Found - If no decklist exists for the player in the given format.

get.summary:

parameters.name: variables.page

The requested size of the page, which may be null.

parameters.name: variables.ignoreCache
parameters.description: Whether to ignore the cache and fetch fresh data. Defaults to false.

200.description: Returns a paginated list of decklists as JSON.

403.description: Forbidden - If the organization associated with the decklists does not have the permission to download decklists.

get.summary: Retrieves details for a specific tournament match by its GUID.

get.summary:
Retrieves detailed information about a specific player by their unique identifier.
Requires staff-level authorization.
get.description:
The endpoint performs an authorization check to ensure that the requestor has the necessary staff-level permissions.
It returns detailed player information, utilizing a mapper to handle player metadata and other sensitive data according to
tournament operations data handling standards.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier for the player.

200.description: Success - Returns a detailed player DTO.

401.description: Unauthorized - The request lacks valid authentication credentials for the requested resource or if the authorization check fails.

404.description: Not Found - A player with the specified ID does not exist.

parameters.name: variables.page

parameters.name: variables.pageSize

The requested size of the page, which may be null.
Minimum size is 5, maximum size is 250, and default size is 25.

parameters.name: variables.ignoreCache
parameters.description: Whether to ignore the cache and fetch fresh data. Defaults to false.

200.description: Returns a list of players within the specified tournament.

403.description: Unauthorized - If the user does not have permission to view the list of players.

get.summary:
Retrieves detailed information about a single player and their associated metadata in key-value form.
Requires staff-level authorization.
get.description:
The endpoint performs an authorization check to ensure that the requestor has the necessary staff-level permissions.
It returns detailed player information, utilizing a mapper to handle player metadata and other sensitive data according to
tournament operations data handling standards.
This method performs authorization checks to verify that the requesting user has permission
to access the list of players. It supports pagination through `ApiPaginationVariables` to efficiently manage the size of the returned data.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the player.

200.description: Success - Returns a detailed player DTO.

401.description: Unauthorized - The request lacks valid authentication credentials for the requested resource or if the authorization check fails.

404.description: Not Found - A player with the specified ID does not exist.

ApiPaginationVariables.description: Defines pagination variables for API requests, including page number and page size with defaults and constraints.

page.description: The requested page number, which may be null. Defaults to 1 if not specified.

pageSize.description:
The requested size of the page, which may be null.
Minimum size is 5, maximum size is 250, and default size is 25.

ignoreCache.description: Whether to ignore the cache and fetch fresh data. Defaults to false.

getPage.description: Gets the effective page number, defaulting to 1 if not specified.

getPageSize.description: Gets the effective page size, applying default, minimum, and maximum constraints.

getOffset.description: Gets the offset for the current page based on the page number and page size.

ApiResult.description: Represents a custom API result incorporating pagination details and supporting sensitive data handling.

hasMore.description: Indicates whether there are more records beyond the current page.

basic.description: The Melee API uses Basic access authentication. Authentication is per-user and requests using these credentials will have access to tournaments that user has access to on the Melee site.
